quotes.name: Harry Hayward
quotes.quote: I mean, the record is the record — 8-1, four straight. That's what we're all carrying. For me, the role shifts game to game, and I just try to be ready for whatever minutes Coach gives me. The Philly night was a good one, but it doesn't change how I approach the next one. You don't overthink it. You just keep playing your part and let the structure hold.
